 Robert Downey Jr, Chris Evans Have A Diwali Gift For India
 Wed, 28 October 2026 
 Share: 
 15:40 
 A scene from Avengers: Doomsday 
 Marvel is ending the year with a surprise for Indian fans. 
 Avengers: Doomsday ’s India release will happen a day before its US release. The Hollywood film is all set to release on Thursday, December 17, in India, in English, Hindi, Tamil and Telugu. 
 Avengers: Doomsday ’s Robert Downey Jr and Chris Evans, who play Doctor Doom and Steve Rogers respectively, have sent a Diwali message to their Indian fans via a special video on Marvel India’s Instagram. 
 'Namaste India! What we love about Diwali is it marks the closing of one chapter and beginning of another... that’s something we know a lot about, except instead of moving from dark to light, I think it might be going in the other direction... Happy Diwali and we will see you in Avengers: Doomsday ,’ RDJ and Evans say.
